headline: Senior Web Developer | WordPress, WooCommerce, Shopify & Next.js
summary: I build new websites and fix the ones already in use. Most of my work is with WordPress, WooCommerce and Shopify. I also build Next.js applications, connect APIs and work on technical SEO, page speed, testing and deployment.

capabilities.title: WordPress websites
capabilities.description: Build and maintain WordPress sites, custom themes, plugins and Elementor pages.

capabilities.title: Online stores
capabilities.description: Build and fix WooCommerce and Shopify stores, product pages and checkout flows.

capabilities.title: Custom web applications
capabilities.description: Build Next.js tools and connect store, customer and order data through APIs.

capabilities.title: SEO and performance
capabilities.description: Fix technical SEO issues, set up analytics and test page speed.

capabilities.title: Live-site support
capabilities.description: Investigate issues, prepare rollback steps, test releases and document changes.
